faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about joining the platform.

items.question: How much does it cost to join?
items.answer: Signing up and listing your services is completely free. We only take a small transparent commission when you complete a booking.

items.question: How do I get paid?
items.answer: Payments are processed securely via Stripe. Once a service is completed, funds are automatically transferred to your connected bank account.

items.question: Can I set my own hours?
items.answer: Yes! You have complete control over your calendar. You decide when you are available for bookings and can update it anytime.

items.question: What if a client cancels?
items.answer: You can define your own cancellation policy. If a client cancels late, you'll still receive a portion of the payment according to your rules.

about.title: About Afrobraid Connect
about.missionText: We are on a mission to empower talented Afro braiders by providing them with the tools they need to run a successful, independent business, while giving clients a seamless, trusted booking experience.
about.storyText: Afrobraid Connect was born out of a simple observation: finding a skilled, reliable Afro hair braider was too difficult, and for braiders, managing bookings, deposits, and schedules was chaotic. We built this platform to bridge that gap. We celebrate cultural heritage while bringing modern convenience to the hair braiding industry.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Afrobraid Connect, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data Collection
dataCollection.text: We collect information you provide directly to us when you create an account, update your profile, or use our services. This includes your name, email address, phone number, and location data.

dataUsage.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
dataUsage.text: Your data is used to provide, maintain, and improve our services, process transactions, send support messages, and communicate with you about products and services.

dataSharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
dataSharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We may share data with trusted third-party vendors (such as Stripe for payments or Veriff for identity verification) solely to provide our services.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to Afrobraid Connect. By accessing our platform, you agree to these terms.

account.title: 1. Account Responsibilities
account.text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.

services.title: 2. Braider Services
services.text: Braiders operate as independent contractors. Afrobraid Connect is a technology platform that connects clients with braiders and does not directly provide braiding services.

payments.title: 3. Payments and Fees
payments.text: All payments must be processed through the platform. Afrobraid Connect charges a transparent service fee on completed bookings as outlined in your dashboard.
